sql: ALTER TABLE loop_item_executions ADD COLUMN executor_owner_user_id INTEGER NOT NULL COMMENT 'User whose Wework runtime owns this execution' DEFAULT '0'
ALTER TABLE loop_item_executions ADD COLUMN automation_run_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL COMMENT 'Owning project automation run id' DEFAULT ''

UPDATE loop_item_executions AS execution LEFT JOIN loop_items AS agent ON agent.id = execution.agent_id SET execution.executor_owner_user_id = COALESCE(agent.created_by_user_id, execution.assigner_user_id, 0)

UPDATE loop_items
SET metadata = JSON_REMOVE(
        JSON_SET(COALESCE(metadata, JSON_OBJECT()), '$.assignment_mode', 'manual'),
        '$.manager_type',
        '$.executor_type'
    ),
    version = version + 1,
    updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
WHERE resource_type = 'automation_rule'
  AND deleted_at IS NULL
  AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(metadata, '$.assignment_mode')) IS NULL
  AND COALESCE(assignee_agent_id, '') <> ''

UPDATE loop_items
SET status = 'disabled',
    metadata = JSON_SET(
        COALESCE(metadata, JSON_OBJECT()),
        '$.migration_error',
        'Legacy automation has no valid assignment configuration; choose an assignment mode.'
    ),
    version = version + 1,
    updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
WHERE resource_type = 'automation_rule'
  AND deleted_at IS NULL
  AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(metadata, '$.assignment_mode')) IS NULL
  AND COALESCE(assignee_agent_id, '') = ''
ALTER TABLE loop_item_executions DROP COLUMN automation_run_id
ALTER TABLE loop_item_executions DROP COLUMN executor_owner_user_id
